website.meta_title: Press Pad Enquiry Guide for Lamination Presses | MOLDART
website.meta_description: A practical RFQ checklist for lamination press pads: construction traceability, dimensions, press/application basis, temperature profile, specific pressure, thermal/compressibility methods, durability, cleanliness and inspection requirements.

technical_validation.source: Moldart Industrial and Architectural Product Specifications - Press Pads row
technical_validation.notes: Qualification remains exact-product and exact-process specific. Comparative laboratory methods can support review where technically appropriate but are not direct production proof.

linkedin.copy: Press-pad qualification becomes more useful when the pad construction, press stack and operating conditions are reviewed together. Our new enquiry guide covers dimensions, temperature profile, specific-pressure basis, comparative thermal/compressibility methods, durability, cleanliness and final disposition - without treating generic cycle-life or thermal claims as universal. Read the guide: {tracked_url}

facebook.copy: Specifying a press pad? Share the actual pad construction/reference, L x W x t, press/application/stack, temperature profile, specific-pressure basis and evaluation method. Generic cycle-life or thermal values are not enough for qualification. Full RFQ guide: {tracked_url}

frames: What to specify for a press-pad enquiry
Press stack + actual temperature + specific-pressure basis
Inspection + final PASS / FAIL / OPEN disposition
instagram.caption: Press-pad evaluation should start from the actual pad construction and press conditions - not from a generic cycle-life claim. Save this checklist for your next RFQ. Full guide via the MOLDART website after release.

cta: Send the pad construction/reference, nominal dimensions, press/application/stack, temperature profile, specific-pressure basis, evaluation methods and quantity for technical review.
